services.value: Accredited environmental testing laboratory services including analyses for asbestos (PCM/PLM/TEM, air monitoring, AHERA clearance, bulk analysis, waste solids), mold, lead and metals, silica, VOC, fire-damage particulate, TCLP, PFAS, and drinking water/wastewater parameters (including E. coli/total coliform and Legionella). Also offers field sampling/field science for on-site collection and provides wholesale lab services with chain-of-custody and reporting.
